text_summary.body: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, appointed over those left in Judah, assured the remaining captains at Mizpah; in the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah of the royal line killed him with Jews and Chaldeans; all the people fled to Egypt.

setting.body: Jeremiah 40–43 gives the fuller account. The seventh-month fast of Zech 7:5; 8:19 is traditionally connected with Gedaliah's murder (not researched here).

constraints.subject: evt_01M4V7CG4K95NPX8VFDZKH577Z
constraints.textual_assertion: But in the seventh month, Ishmael … struck Gedaliah
assumptions: The year is not stated; most readers take the same year as the destruction, but that is not modelled.

competing_reconstructions.label: Same year as the destruction
competing_reconstructions.summary: The seventh month after the burning in the fifth.

competing_reconstructions.label: A later year
competing_reconstructions.summary: The text gives no year; Jer 52:30's deportation in Nebuchadnezzar's 23rd year has been connected with the aftermath by some (not verified).

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik narrates Gedaliah's appointment, his assassination in the seventh month and the flight to Egypt.
